decisions.reason: The candidate's message-143 INTRODUCE already records the FAQ explanation that winner selection uses Chainlink VRF on-chain and is verifiable on Basescan.
The Chainlink VRF selection decision does not change the Small Block prize amounts, winner count, funding sources, or draw trigger owned by this Requirement.
The Chainlink VRF selection decision does not change the Big Block prize amounts, winner count, funding sources, or draw trigger owned by this Requirement.
Winner-selection randomness and verifiability do not alter the existing one-click manual prize-claim flow or its Winners-page location.
Using Chainlink VRF to select winners does not alter ticket issuance, weighting, eligibility windows, counters, or post-draw resets.
The winner-selection provider does not change the flat secondary royalty, its visibility, founder allocation, pool destinations, or ticket treatment.
The Chainlink VRF selection decision does not change mint price or allocation of primary-mint revenue among the founder, referrer, and prize pools.
The source establishes how winners are selected but does not require any change to the NFT metadata fields for ticket counters, badges, or referral codes.
The winner-selection mechanism is independent of badge designs, referral milestones, on-chain badge storage, and badge effects.
Chainlink VRF prize selection does not affect the Transak provider, fiat conversion, supported payment methods, or wallet-free fiat-mint behavior.
The winner-selection provider does not change which book, referral code, badges, or expired-ticket state transfers with an NFT resale.
The source retains Base as the network and only specifies Chainlink VRF for prize selection; it does not change the candidate's target blockchain or network layer.
